WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID, 
        Segment, 
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption,
        COUNT(*) AS Count
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date = '201301'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID, 
        Segment, 
        AVG(Consumption) AS AvgConsumption
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID, 
        Segment, 
        MIN(Consumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg_min AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID, 
        Segment, 
        AVG(Consumption) AS AvgConsumption
    FROM segment_min
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.CustomerID, 
        s1.Segment, 
        s1.AvgConsumption - s2.AvgConsumption AS AvgDiff
    FROM segment_avg s1
    JOIN segment_avg s2 ON s1.CustomerID = s2.CustomerID AND s1.Segment = s2.Segment
),

SELECT m.first_name , m.last_name , m.phone AS contact_number
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.link_to_member = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.link_to_budget
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)
GROUP BY m.first_name , m.last_name , m.phone
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_in_patients ,
    COUNT(*) as total_out_patients ,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as in_patients ,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as out_patients ,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as male_in_patients ,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as male_out_patients ,
    ROUND( (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 , 2 ) as percentage_deviation
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Examination.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination)
GROUP BY Examination.ID
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

SELECT c.name , c.nationality , c.score
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
  AND r.name = "Monaco Grand Prix"
  AND cs.status = "1"
ORDER BY c.score DESC
LIMIT 1
